cases.situation: Want to write a LinkedIn recommendation for Marco, who was my direct report for 2 years as a customer support lead. He built our help center from scratch, 140 articles in his first six months, and ticket volume dropped about 35 percent. He also trained our new agents patiently, always using real tickets.
cases.reply: I managed Marco for two years while he led our customer support team. He built our help center from nothing, 140 articles in his first six months, and ticket volume dropped by about 35 percent as a result. What stood out was how he trained new agents: patient, practical, and always with real tickets. I'd hire him again tomorrow.
cases.note: How you know him, two strengths with numbers, a clear endorsement. Short enough for LinkedIn.

cases.situation: 以前实习时带过的学生小韩请我给她写出国读研的推荐信，但她只在我们组待了两个月，工作一般，我觉得写不出有分量的东西。她的毕设指导老师带了她一年多。想婉拒。
cases.reply: 小韩，谢谢你想到我，也祝申请顺利。认真想了一下，我觉得我不是最合适的推荐人，我们一起工作只有两个月，能写的具体内容有限，反而可能拖累你的材料。你毕设的指导老师看到你的时间更长，应该能给你一封更有力的推荐信。
cases.note: 写不出强推荐就趁早温和地拒绝，比写一封平淡的信对她更好。

cases.situation: Getting a reference call Thursday for my ex-colleague Sam, who's applying for an ops manager job. He renegotiated our three biggest logistics contracts, saving about $220,000 a year, and kept all three vendors on good terms. But he had one direct report for about eight months and found giving tough feedback hard; they'll probably ask about people management.
cases.reply: On people management, I can only speak to a small part of it: Sam had one direct report for about eight months, and he found giving tough feedback hard early on. Where he really stood out was vendor negotiation. He renegotiated our three biggest logistics contracts and saved about $220,000 a year, while keeping every one of those relationships friendly.
cases.note: Narrow the scope instead of stretching the truth: answer the weakness briefly and factually, then give the strongest true evidence.

cases.situation: 家里请了四年的住家阿姨刘桂芳，我们叫她刘姐，2022年10月来的，主要做饭和照顾我们两个孩子。我们要搬去上海，她想在北京找新雇主，请我写一段推荐发给中介，可以留我的电话138 0000 0008。她做饭讲营养，把两个孩子挑食的毛病慢慢带好了；有一次小儿子半夜高烧，是她起来查看时发现的，马上叫醒我们，很冷静。
cases.reply: 刘桂芳大姐在我们家做住家阿姨四年，从2022年10月到今年10月，主要负责做饭和照顾两个孩子。她特别细心：有一次半夜小儿子发高烧，是她起来查看时发现的，马上叫醒我们，处理得很冷静。她做饭讲究营养搭配，两个孩子挑食的毛病都是她慢慢带好的。我们因为搬家才不得不分开，非常放心地推荐她。如需了解，欢迎联系我：138 0000 0008。
cases.note: 私人推荐也要写清认识多久、做什么，再用一两个具体的事说话，最后给联系方式。不写她的年龄、家庭或身体情况。

cases.situation: I'm Martin Hale, a small landlord. My tenant Aisha Bello has rented my one-bedroom flat at 14 Grove Road since October 2023 at £1,150 a month, always paid on time, and I manage it myself; she's moving to Manchester and her new letting agent emailed asking for a reference. When a pipe burst last winter she shut off the water, called me within minutes and kept a photo log for the insurer. My number is 07700 900318.
cases.reply: Hello, I'm happy to give a reference for Aisha Bello. She has rented my one-bedroom flat at 14 Grove Road since October 2023, and I've managed the tenancy myself throughout. In those three years her rent of £1,150 a month has been paid on time every month. When a pipe burst in the kitchen last winter, she shut off the water, called me within minutes and kept a photo log for the insurer, which saved us both a great deal of trouble. I'd let to her again without hesitation, and you're welcome to call me on 07700 900318. Best regards, Martin Hale
cases.note: A landlord reference is still how you know them, specific evidence, and a clear endorsement; stick to what a letting agent actually needs and nothing personal.

cases.situation: My former manager Dana was just laid off in a restructure and is job hunting; I want to write her a LinkedIn recommendation. She managed me for 3 years on the seven-person data team at Quill, led us through a platform migration that ran four months over without anyone leaving, and pushed me into my first conference talk, rehearsing it with me for two evenings. She'd be applying for engineering manager roles.
cases.reply: Dana managed me for three years on the data team at Quill, and she is the best manager I've had. She led our team of seven through a platform migration that ran four months over, and nobody left, which says a lot about how she treats people under pressure. She also saw something in me before I did: she pushed me to give my first conference talk and spent two evenings rehearsing it with me. Any team hiring a hands-on engineering manager would be lucky to have her.
cases.note: Upward recommendations carry weight because the writer was the one managed: one example about delivery, one about people. Leave the layoff out.

cases.situation: My former colleague Jordan asked for a LinkedIn recommendation and sent me a draft to post. Most of it is fair, including his vendor onboarding numbers and how he handled the March outage, but it says he 'led our platform strategy', which was our director Nadia's call; what he actually did was drive the rollout across four regional teams. I don't want to sign something untrue or make it awkward.
cases.reply: Happy to do this, Jordan. I've tweaked your draft so it's all things I saw myself. I kept the vendor onboarding numbers and the bit about the March outage, both spot on. I swapped 'led our platform strategy' for 'drove the platform rollout across four regional teams', since the strategy was Nadia's call and a hiring manager could easily check. That line is true and still strong. If you're good with it, I'll post it tonight.
cases.note: When someone drafts their own reference, edit to what you can stand behind and say why in one line; offering a strong true replacement keeps it from feeling like a rejection.

cases.situation: I'm Maria Ortiz, AP Chemistry teacher at Lincoln High; my student Jaylen Brooks wants a letter for the Hartwell STEM Scholarship, due Oct 15, and plans to study environmental engineering. I taught him two years and supervised his project testing 62 drinking fountains across nine district schools: three were above the EPA lead action level, he presented to the school board, and they replaced all three within a month. Classmates go to him when stuck and he never makes them feel slow; contact 555-014-2290, m.ortiz@example.com.
cases.reply:
Dear Scholarship Committee,
I'm pleased to recommend Jaylen Brooks for the Hartwell STEM Scholarship. I taught Jaylen AP Chemistry for two years at Lincoln High and supervised his independent project on lead in our district's drinking fountains. He tested 62 fountains across nine schools, found three above the EPA action level, and presented the results to the school board, which replaced all three within a month. In class he is the student others turn to when they're stuck, and he explains without making anyone feel slow. I recommend him without hesitation for a degree in environmental engineering, and I'd be glad to talk further: 555-014-2290 or m.ortiz@example.com.
Sincerely,
Maria Ortiz
cases.note: Academic letter: how you know him, one project with numbers and a real outcome, one trait with an example, then an endorsement tied to what he'll study.

cases.situation: 前下属小罗请我当她的背调联系人，我当时一口答应了。今天她说应聘的是财务经理，要带五个人。她跟我那两年做应收会计，业务很扎实，把月底对账从六天压到了三天，但从没带过人，管理这块我说不上话；王姐见过她带项目、协调别人。
cases.reply: 小罗，背调的事我又想了想，想提前跟你说清楚。你做应收那两年的专业能力我可以很有底气地讲，比如你把月底对账从六天压到了三天。但这个岗位要带五个人，管理这块我没见你做过，对方要是重点问，我只能如实说不在我看到的范围里。要不要再加一位见过你带项目、协调别人的推荐人，比如王姐？专业这部分我照样全力讲。
cases.note: 答应后才发现只能讲一部分：提前私下说清能讲什么、不能讲什么，再帮她找一位能补上的推荐人。

cases.situation: I'm Megan Shaw, reachable on 07700 900318 or m.shaw@example.com. Laura Grant, hiring manager at Fenwick Studio, emailed asking for a reference for Tariq Hassan, applying for Design Lead; we were at Northlight Agency 2023 to 2025, me on product, him on brand, and we're now close friends. I saw him lead three designers on the Halden Bank rebrand, delivered in ten weeks, a month early, and two designers he mentored were promoted within a year; I never saw his day-to-day management.
cases.reply:
Hi Laura,
Thanks for getting in touch about Tariq. So you can weigh this properly: Tariq and I worked at Northlight Agency from 2023 to 2025 on neighbouring teams, me on product and him on brand, and we've since become close friends. I saw his work most closely on the Halden Bank rebrand, where he led three designers and delivered the full identity in ten weeks, a month ahead of plan. He was also the person juniors went to for crits; two designers he mentored were promoted within a year. I wasn't on his team, so I can't speak to his day-to-day management. For a design lead role I recommend him strongly, and I'm glad to talk: 07700 900318 or m.shaw@example.com.
Best,
Megan Shaw
cases.note: Disclosing the friendship and naming what you did not see makes the specific evidence more credible, not less.

cases.situation: I'm Daniel Price. My neighbour's daughter, Ella Moore (16), has babysat our two kids, aged 5 and 8, about twice a month for a year and has never been late; last spring, when our son cut his hand on a glass, she bandaged it calmly and called us straight away. She's applying for her first job at Beanstalk Café and the manager, Ms Carter, wants a personal reference by email. My number is 07700 900312.
cases.reply:
Dear Ms Carter,
I'm writing in support of Ella Moore's application. Ella has babysat our two children, aged 5 and 8, about twice a month for the past year, so I know her as a neighbour and as someone we trust with our kids. She has never once been late, and when our son cut his hand on a glass last spring, she cleaned and bandaged it calmly and called us straight away with a clear update. I'd expect her to be just as reliable behind a café counter, and I recommend her warmly. I'm happy to talk on 07700 900312.
Kind regards,
Daniel Price
cases.note: With no work history, a personal reference does what a CV can't: a pattern of reliability and one moment under pressure.

cases.situation: I'm Rosa Delgado, volunteer coordinator at the Eastside Community Pantry. Kenji Mori has volunteered with us every Saturday for two years and is applying for a Master of Social Work at Ridgeway University. I saw him set up our Saturday intake desk, which cut the morning queue from about 45 minutes to 20, and he trained six new volunteers. I only see him on Saturdays and know nothing about his academic work. My contact is 555-018-7734 or rosa.delgado@example.com.
cases.reply:
Dear Admissions Committee,
I'm pleased to recommend Kenji Mori for the Master of Social Work. As volunteer coordinator at the Eastside Community Pantry, I have worked with Kenji every Saturday for two years. He set up our Saturday intake desk, which cut the morning queue from about 45 minutes to 20, and he has trained six new volunteers. I know Kenji through his volunteering, not his academic work, so I'll leave that to his other referees. For a programme built on practical work with people in need, I recommend him strongly. I'd be glad to talk further: 555-018-7734 or rosa.delgado@example.com.
Sincerely,
Rosa Delgado
cases.note: A volunteer reference: say exactly where you saw him, give the evidence you have, and name what you didn't see instead of guessing.

cases.situation: I'm Hannah Cole, operations manager at Brightwell Logistics. Our reference policy, which applies to every former employee, lets me confirm only dates of employment and job title. A recruiter, Ben Okafor at Larch Health, emailed asking for a full reference for Sofia Reyes, who was our Warehouse Supervisor from 7 March 2022 to 28 August 2026. I rated her highly and don't want the short answer to look like a warning.
cases.reply:
Hi Ben,
Thanks for getting in touch about Sofia Reyes. Under Brightwell Logistics' reference policy, I can confirm dates of employment and job title only: Sofia worked for us as Warehouse Supervisor from 7 March 2022 to 28 August 2026. The policy applies to every former employee, so please don't read anything into the brevity.
Best regards,
Hannah Cole
cases.note: When policy limits you to dates and title, say it's standard so the short answer isn't read as faint praise; check with HR before adding anything personal.

cases.situation: Someone in our neighbourhood WhatsApp group asked if anyone knows a good electrician. We used Dev Sandhu to rewire our kitchen in July: he quoted £1,850, finished in the two days he said, the final bill matched the quote, and he left the place spotless. That's the only job he's done for us. His number is 07700 900527.
cases.reply: We used Dev Sandhu to rewire our kitchen in July. He quoted £1,850, finished in the two days he said he would, and the final bill matched the quote exactly. He also left the place spotless. That's the only job he's done for us, so I can't speak to bigger work, but I'd call him again. His number is 07700 900527.
cases.note: A recommendation in a group chat: what he did for you, the evidence people care about (price, time, tidiness), and the honest limit of what you saw.

cases.situation: Ich bin Teamleiterin im Entwicklungsteam von Kranich Software und schreibe den Leistungsteil für das Arbeitszeugnis unseres Werkstudenten Felix Bauer, der vom 1. März 2024 bis 30. September 2026 bei uns war und geht, weil sein Studium endet. Er hat die automatisierte Testabdeckung unserer Kernanwendung eigenständig von 40 auf 75 Prozent erhöht und zwei neue Werkstudenten eingearbeitet, die nach wenigen Wochen selbstständig arbeiteten. Ich war sehr zufrieden und möchte, dass das im Zeugnis auch so ankommt.
cases.reply: Herr Felix Bauer war vom 1. März 2024 bis zum 30. September 2026 als Werkstudent in unserem Entwicklungsteam tätig. Er hat die automatisierte Testabdeckung unserer Kernanwendung eigenständig von 40 auf 75 Prozent erhöht. Zudem hat er zwei neue Werkstudenten eingearbeitet, die bereits nach wenigen Wochen selbstständig arbeiteten. Die ihm übertragenen Aufgaben erledigte er stets zu unserer vollsten Zufriedenheit. Herr Bauer verlässt uns, weil sein Studium endet. Wir bedauern sein Ausscheiden sehr, danken ihm für seine wertvolle Arbeit und wünschen ihm für seinen weiteren Weg alles Gute.
cases.note: Zeugnissprache ist codiert: „stets zu unserer vollsten Zufriedenheit“ gilt als Bestnote, also nur so schreiben, wenn man es meint; Formulierungen im Zweifel mit HR prüfen.

cases.situation: 我是客服部主管。组员李悦想内部转岗到产品部，产品部的周经理在企业微信上问我对她的看法。李悦跟了我两年半，去年她把客户投诉最多的20个问题整理成报告交给产品部，其中6个已经改进上线了。她没做过产品经理，需求文档这块我没见过她写。
cases.reply: 周经理您好，李悦在我们客服组两年半，一直是我直接带的。她最突出的是能从大量客户反馈里抓住重点：去年她把投诉最多的20个问题整理成报告交给你们产品部，其中6个已经改进上线了。需求文档这块我没见过她写，就不评价了。但要说懂用户、能把问题讲清楚，我非常推荐她。需要细聊的话随时找我。
cases.note: 内部推荐：说清你带了她多久、一个有结果的具体例子，没见过的部分直接说明，不替她打包票。

cases.situation: I'm Gareth Lloyd, former head of finance at Mercer & Vale. Imani Brooks was my financial analyst from 2016 to 2020, then took five years out to care for a family member; she's applying for a senior analyst role at Ashgrove Health and asked me for a reference letter. In 2019 she built the cash-flow model that flagged a £400,000 shortfall three months early, and she trained two junior analysts to use it. Contact: 07700 900641, g.lloyd@example.com.
cases.reply:
Dear Hiring Manager,
I'm pleased to recommend Imani Brooks for the Senior Analyst role at Ashgrove Health. I managed Imani as a financial analyst at Mercer & Vale from 2016 to 2020. In 2019 she built the cash-flow model that flagged a £400,000 shortfall three months before it would have landed, and she trained two junior analysts to use it. My knowledge of her work covers those four years, and on that basis I recommend her strongly for a senior analyst role. I'd be glad to talk further: 07700 900641 or g.lloyd@example.com.
Yours faithfully,
Gareth Lloyd
cases.note: After a career break, vouch for the years you saw and say which they were; the reason for the gap is hers to share, not yours.

cases.situation: Our company asks peers to write a short statement for promotion cases. My peer Ines, a backend engineer, is up for Staff. I've worked with her for 18 months on the search team: she designed the indexing pipeline that cut search latency from 900ms to 250ms, and after the June outage she ran the incident review that got three teams to agree on fixes. I haven't seen her do cross-org planning, which is one of the Staff criteria.
cases.reply: I've worked alongside Ines on the search team for 18 months. She designed our indexing pipeline, which cut search latency from 900ms to 250ms. After the June outage she ran the incident review, and it was her facilitation that got three teams to agree on fixes. I haven't worked with her on cross-org planning, so I'll leave that criterion to people who have. On technical design and leading across teams in a crisis, I support her promotion to Staff strongly.
cases.note: A peer statement for a promotion: map your evidence to the criteria you saw and name the one you didn't, so the committee trusts the rest.

cases.situation: I'm head chef at Larder & Vine. Tomasz Nowak worked my grill station for two years and left in August; in his last year he ran grill on his own on Saturdays, around 180 covers a night, and he trained our two newer cooks on steak temperatures. Chef Maya Okonkwo from another restaurant just messaged me on WhatsApp asking if he can handle her Saturday-night grill alone. I'd hire him back.
cases.reply: Hi Maya, yes, he can. Tomasz worked my grill for two years, and for his last year he ran it on his own on Saturdays, around 180 covers a night. He also trained our two newer cooks on steak temperatures. I'd hire him back. Happy to talk if you want more.
cases.note: A quick reference by message: answer her exact question first, then the evidence that matches it.

cases.situation: 好朋友陈默想从一家流浪猫救助站领养一只三岁的猫，救助站的志愿者小林加了我微信，请我作为推荐人说说她养宠物的情况。我认识陈默十年，她养的上一只猫团团活到16岁，最后两年得了肾病，她每天在家给团团打皮下补液，我去她家时见过好几次。她现在的住处我还没去过。
cases.reply: 小林你好，我是陈默的朋友，认识她十年了。她养的上一只猫团团活到16岁，最后两年得了肾病，她每天在家给团团打皮下补液，我去她家时亲眼见过好几次，一直很耐心、很细致。她现在的住处我还没去过，这部分就不评价了。就照顾猫这件事，我非常放心地推荐她。还有想了解的，随时微信问我。
cases.note: 领养推荐也一样：说清认识多久，用亲眼见过的事说话，没见过的直接说明。

cases.situation: I maintain an open-source charting library, Plotwick. Farah Siddiqui has contributed for 14 months: she rewrote our date-axis code, which closed 31 open bugs, and she's reviewed about 120 pull requests from new contributors, kindly and specifically enough that several first-timers came back with a second one. We've only ever worked together online, I've never seen her in a regular job, and she's asked me for a LinkedIn recommendation.
cases.reply: I've worked with Farah on the open-source charting library Plotwick for 14 months, entirely online. She rewrote our date-axis code, which closed 31 open bugs in one go. She has also reviewed about 120 pull requests from new contributors, and her feedback is so kind and specific that several first-timers came back with a second one. I know her through open source rather than a day job, and on that basis I recommend her strongly to any team that values careful code and generous review.
cases.note: An online-only collaboration is real evidence: say where you saw the work and scope the endorsement to it.

cases.situation: Sou a Camila Rocha, dona da padaria Pão da Vila, em Belo Horizonte. O designer freelancer Rafael Lima fez a nossa identidade visual e as embalagens entre junho e agosto: entregou tudo uma semana antes do prazo, apresentou três propostas de logo explicando cada escolha, e desde a troca das embalagens as encomendas para presente passaram de 15 para 40 por mês. Ele me pediu um depoimento curto para o site dele; só fizemos esse projeto juntos, e eu o contrataria de novo.
cases.reply:
A Pão da Vila contratou o Rafael Lima para criar a nossa identidade visual e as embalagens, entre junho e agosto. Ele entregou tudo uma semana antes do prazo e apresentou três propostas de logo, explicando cada escolha. Desde que trocamos as embalagens, as encomendas para presente passaram de 15 para 40 por mês. Foi o único projeto que fizemos juntos, e eu contrataria o Rafael de novo.
Camila Rocha, Pão da Vila, Belo Horizonte
cases.note: Depoimento para site: curto, com um resultado em número e o limite do que você viu, para quem lê confiar no resto.

cases.situation: 公司年底评“年度服务之星”，每个主管可以提名一人，要写一段200字以内的推荐理由。我提名组里的客服专员何静，我带了她三年：她今年把自己的平均首次响应时间从4小时缩短到1小时，还主动整理了一份新人应答手册，今年入职的三位新同事第一周就能独立接单。
cases.reply: 我提名客服专员何静为年度服务之星。我带了她三年。今年她把自己的平均首次响应时间从4小时缩短到了1小时。她还主动整理了一份新人应答手册，今年入职的三位新同事第一周就能独立接单。她不只自己做得好，也让新人上手更快。我毫无保留地推荐她。
cases.note: 提名也是推荐：说清你怎么认识她，用数字说话，只写你亲眼看到的。

cases.situation: My friend Owen Price has pleaded guilty to drink-driving and his solicitor has asked me for a character reference for the magistrates by Friday 9 October; Owen has told me about the charge. I've known him 12 years, and for the last five we've coached an under-10s football team together every Saturday, where he organises the minibus rota and the kit fund. Since his arrest in July he's sold his car and cycles to training. I'm Helen Moore, 07700 900284, helen.moore@example.com.
cases.reply:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm writing as a character referee for Owen Price. I have known Owen for 12 years, and for the last five we have coached an under-10s football team together every Saturday. He has told me about the drink-driving charge he has pleaded guilty to. Throughout those five years he has organised the team's minibus rota and kit fund. Since July he has sold his car and now cycles to training. I can speak only to what I have seen as his friend and fellow coach, and on that basis I know him as a reliable and committed person. I'm happy to be contacted on 07700 900284 or helen.moore@example.com.
Yours faithfully,
Helen Moore
cases.note: Ask his solicitor what the court needs; show you know the offence, vouch only for what you've seen, and leave the case and sentence alone.

cases.situation: I'm Grace Liu. My friends Ana Ferreira and Tom Becker are applying for a partner visa, and their lawyer asked me for a short letter about their relationship by Friday 16 October. I've known Ana since university in 2015 and met Tom in March 2023 when she brought him to my birthday; I've stayed twice at the Bristol flat they've shared since January 2024, and they came to my wedding together in June 2025. I'm on 07700 900415 and grace.liu@example.com.
cases.reply:
To whom it may concern,
I'm writing in support of Ana Ferreira and Tom Becker. I have known Ana since we were at university together in 2015, and I met Tom in March 2023, when Ana brought him to my birthday. Since January 2024 they have shared a flat in Bristol, where I have stayed with them twice. They also came to my wedding together in June 2025. I can speak only to what I have seen as their friend, and on that basis I know them as a committed couple. I'm happy to be contacted on 07700 900415 or grace.liu@example.com.
Yours faithfully,
Grace Liu
cases.note: Ask their lawyer what format the application needs; give only dates and visits you saw yourself, and don't vouch for anything beyond them.

cases.situation: 我是一家书店的店长。前店员苏晴2024年3月到2026年8月在我们店工作，离职是因为考了保育员证想转行做幼教，现在她应聘一家幼儿园的保育员，幼儿园发来背调表，问工作表现、离职原因、是否愿意再次雇用，以及“是否了解任何让她不适合与儿童相处的情况”。她主持了一年多的周末绘本故事会，报名从每场十来个孩子涨到三十个左右，常有家长专门来夸她；在职期间没有任何投诉或违纪，我只在店里见过她和孩子相处。我愿意再雇用她。
cases.reply: 苏晴2024年3月至2026年8月在我们书店任店员，我是她的直属店长。她离职是因为考取了保育员证，想转行做幼教。她最让我放心的是主持周末绘本故事会：她带了一年多，报名从每场十来个孩子涨到三十个左右，常有家长专门来跟我们夸她。在职期间她没有任何投诉或违纪记录，我不了解任何让她不适合与儿童相处的情况；需要说明的是，我只在书店里见过她和孩子相处。如有机会，我很愿意再次雇用她。
cases.note: 背调表里关于儿童安全的问题要如实回答，并说明你看到的范围，不替对方打包票。

cases.situation: I'm Ruth Adler. Grace Mensah was a home carer for my dad, Leon, three mornings a week through an agency from March 2024 until he died in August 2026. She learned his medication routine so well that twice she noticed a missed evening dose and flagged it, and she kept him walking to the end of the garden most days. She's applying to a care home, Elmwood House, and the manager asked me for a personal reference by email; I'm on 07700 900762 and ruth.adler@example.com, and I only ever saw her work in Dad's home.
cases.reply:
Dear Manager,
I'm writing in support of Grace Mensah's application. Grace cared for my father, Leon, three mornings a week from March 2024 until he died in August 2026, so I saw her work week in, week out for over two years. She learned his medication routine so well that twice she noticed a missed evening dose and flagged it straight away. She also kept him walking to the end of the garden most days. I saw her work only in his home, not in a residential setting, and on that basis I recommend her warmly. I'm happy to talk on 07700 900762 or at ruth.adler@example.com.
Kind regards,
Ruth Adler
cases.note: A family reference for a carer: how often you saw her work, two specific moments, and the limit of the setting you saw.

cases.situation: I'm Dan Lee, head coach at Riverside Rowing Club. Nia Adebayo, 18, has rowed with us for four years and needs a reference letter for a sports scholarship at Ashford University by Friday 16 October. This season she captained our junior squad and organised the 5am winter training rota for 12 juniors, and at the summer regatta, when our stroke was injured that morning, she switched seats and the crew still won silver; I know nothing about her grades. I'm on 555-0134 and coach.lee@example.com.
cases.reply: I'm pleased to recommend Nia Adebayo for the sports scholarship at Ashford University. I'm head coach at Riverside Rowing Club and have coached Nia for four years. This season she captained our junior squad and organised the 5am winter training rota for 12 juniors. At our summer regatta, when our stroke was injured on the morning of the race, Nia switched seats at short notice and the crew still won silver. I can't speak to her academic work, but as an athlete and a leader I recommend her strongly, and I'd be glad to talk further: 555-0134 or coach.lee@example.com. Dan Lee
cases.note: Name the limit of what you saw (her grades) in one clause, then go back to the strong evidence.

cases.situation: 物流会社で課長をしている田中裕子です。元部下の小林健太さん（2022年4月〜2026年3月在籍）の転職先候補、コハク物流の人事の森さんからメールで照会があり、「懸念点があれば教えてください」とも聞かれました。小林さんは2024年に発注ミスで約80万円の損失を出しましたが、すぐ自分から報告して再発防止のチェックリストを作り、その後同じミスはありません。在庫管理を任せてからは棚卸差異を1年で半分に減らし、またぜひ一緒に働きたい人です。
cases.reply:
森様
お問い合わせいただきありがとうございます。田中裕子と申します。小林健太さんは2022年4月から2026年3月まで、私の課で直属の部下として勤務していました。在庫管理を任せてからの1年で、棚卸差異を半分に減らしてくれました。懸念点についてのご質問ですが、2024年に発注ミスで約80万円の損失を出したことがあります。ただ、本人がすぐに自分から報告し、再発防止のチェックリストを作成して、それ以降同じミスは一度もありません。機会があれば、また一緒に働きたいと思っている人です。
田中裕子
cases.note: 懸念点を聞かれたら、事実を一つ短く述べ、その後の対応とセットで伝える。元社員の照会に答える前に社内規定も確認する。

cases.situation: Last Monday I agreed to be a referee for my old teammate Leo Marsh. Today he told me the role is Head of Engineering at Fernhollow Health, managing 20 engineers and a budget, with reference calls next week. I only worked with him for 8 months as a fellow mobile developer; his manager then, Priyanka Shah, saw him lead the offline-sync project, and I'm still in touch with her.
cases.reply: Leo, now I know it's Head of Engineering, I've thought again and I'm not the right referee for this one. I only saw you as a fellow mobile dev for 8 months, so I can't speak to leading 20 engineers or running a budget, and a thin reference could hurt you more than help. Priyanka saw you lead the offline-sync project and would be far stronger. Would you like me to message her and say I think she'd be a great referee for you? Sorry for changing my answer.
cases.note: Backing out early, privately, with a better referee in hand is kinder than a vague call next week.

cases.situation: I'm Sam Okoro, owner of Brightside Bikes, a repair shop with six staff. Our mechanic Lena Hoffmann has worked for us full time since May 2023 on a permanent contract, and she's asked me to confirm her job and her $46,000 salary to a letting agent, Paul Grey, who has emailed me for an employment reference. She runs the workshop on her own on Saturdays and has never missed a shift without notice; my number is 555-0172.
cases.reply: Hi Paul, thanks for getting in touch; Lena has asked me to give this reference. Lena Hoffmann has worked full time at Brightside Bikes as a mechanic since May 2023, on a permanent contract, with a salary of $46,000 a year. As the owner I see her work every week: she runs our workshop on her own on Saturdays and has never missed a shift without notice. I recommend her as reliable without hesitation, and you're welcome to call me on 555-0172. Best regards, Sam Okoro, Brightside Bikes
cases.note: Share pay only because she asked you to; for a landlord, stick to job, tenure, pay and reliability.

cases.situation: 我叫苏然，和室友唐悦在上海合租了两年（2024年9月到今年9月）。房租和水电由我统一交，她每个月都提前转给我，一次没晚过；厨房和卫生间按轮值表打扫，她从没缺过，晚上11点以后基本就很安静。她要搬去深圳租三人合租的房间，那边的房东徐先生加了我微信想了解她；她的工作和收入我不了解。
cases.reply: 徐先生您好，我是苏然，和唐悦在上海合租了两年，从2024年9月到今年9月。房租和水电由我统一交，她每个月都提前转给我，两年里一次都没晚过。厨房和卫生间我们按轮值表打扫，她从没缺过一次；晚上11点以后她那边基本就很安静了。她的工作和收入我不了解，这部分就不评价了。作为室友，我非常放心地推荐她。
cases.note: 室友推荐：说清合住多久，用付钱、打扫、作息这些房东真正关心的事说话，不了解的部分直接说明。

cases.situation: I'm Joel Park and I run the monthly Data Visualization meetup in Leeds. Kavya Rao gave a 20-minute talk at our June meetup on making accessible charts: 85 people came, our biggest turnout, and 40 of the 52 who filled in our feedback form rated it 5 out of 5; she has never spoken at a conference. Dr Ellen Shaw, who organises the Northcharts conference, asked meetup leads to suggest first-time speakers by email, and Kavya has asked me to put her name forward.
cases.reply: Hi Ellen, I'd like to suggest Kavya Rao as a first-time speaker for Northcharts. I run the monthly Data Visualization meetup in Leeds, and Kavya gave a 20-minute talk at our June meetup on making accessible charts. It drew 85 people, our biggest turnout so far, and 40 of the 52 people who filled in our feedback form rated it 5 out of 5. I've only seen her speak that once, so I can't say how she'd handle a longer slot, but for a short talk on accessibility I recommend her strongly. Happy to introduce you both. Best, Joel Park
cases.note: Putting someone forward unasked by the reader: say where you saw them, give the numbers, and scope the endorsement to that one talk.

cases.situation: I'm Owen Reid, manager of Corner Shelf, a bookshop. Maya Patel worked for us part time from June 2024 to August 2026 and is applying to be a pharmacy assistant at Linwood Pharmacy; their reference form asks about customer service, reliability and punctuality, and whether I'd re-employ her. Regulars asked for her by name and she ran our stock system on her own through our busiest Christmas, but in her first six months she was late around ten times, which stopped once we moved her start time from 8am to 10am; I'd re-employ her on shifts starting at 10am or later.
cases.reply:
Customer service: Maya was the strongest person on our till. Several regulars asked for her by name, and she ran our stock system on her own through our busiest Christmas.
Reliability and punctuality: in her first six months she was late around ten times. That stopped once we moved her start time from 8am to 10am, and she was on time from then on.
Would you re-employ: yes, on shifts starting at 10am or later.
Owen Reid, Manager, Corner Shelf
cases.note: A reservation goes in as one factual line with what changed after it; leave out reasons you weren't told or that are hers to share.

cases.situation: I'm Nora, finance manager at Tallis & Co. I managed Ben Carter as an accountant from 2022 to 2026: he closed year-end on time every year, and he set up our expense approval workflow, which cut processing from 10 days to 3. On his reference call, the hiring manager, Carl, has just asked: 'How much sick leave did he take? I heard he had some health stuff.' I won't discuss Ben's health or leave.
cases.reply: That's not something I'll go into, Carl; I keep health and leave out of references. What I can speak to is his work. He closed year-end on time every year I managed him, and he set up our expense approval workflow, which cut processing from 10 days to 3. I'm happy to answer anything else about how he did the job.
cases.note: Decline the health question in one line without hinting either way, then go straight back to the evidence; check your HR policy on what you can share.

cases.situation: Our startup, Pinefold, shut down last week. I was head of design and managed Ollie Grant, a product designer, for two years: he ran 30 user interviews that led us to redesign onboarding, which lifted activation from 22% to 31%, and he built our design system on his own. He's looking for product design roles and asked me to post about him on LinkedIn, and he's happy for people to message him directly. I'd hire him again tomorrow.
cases.reply: Pinefold closed last week, and Ollie Grant, the product designer I managed for two years, is looking for his next role. Ollie ran the 30 user interviews that led us to redesign our onboarding, and activation went from 22% to 31%. He also built our design system on his own. If you're hiring a product designer, talk to him; he's happy for you to message him directly. I'd hire him again tomorrow.
cases.note: A public post for someone job hunting: post only with their go-ahead, lead with what they're looking for, and back it with one result.

cases.situation: I'm Priya Nair, engineering manager at Coldharbour Labs. Marcus Webb was on my team from 2023 to July 2025; we clashed over his request to go fully remote and he resigned in a tense team meeting. His work was strong: he built our billing reconciliation service, which cut failed payments by 18%, and he wrote the on-call runbook the team still uses. A recruiter, Jo Kim at Saltmarsh Software, emailed asking about his technical work, and I want to be fair to him.
cases.reply:
Hi Jo,
Thanks for getting in touch about Marcus. I managed Marcus Webb at Coldharbour Labs from 2023 to July 2025. His technical work was strong: he built our billing reconciliation service, which cut failed payments by 18%, and he wrote the on-call runbook our team still uses today. For a role built on careful backend engineering, I recommend him.
Best regards,
Priya Nair
cases.note: A personal clash is not evidence about someone's work: answer what was asked, keep to what you saw, and leave the falling-out out.
